lines: George Orwell wrote: “To see what is in front of your nose needs constant effort.”
We are surrounded by many chances, but often we do not see them.
Professor Richard Wiseman did an exciting and impressive test of this.
He asked the participants to count how many times a basketball team passed the ball.
During the test, a man in a gorilla suit walked into the middle of the group, beat his chest a bit and then walked off.
Quite a few participants counted correctly, but only 5 out of over 20 participants noticed the gorilla.
The same applies to our professional lives.
We are so focused on keeping score and managing day to day that we do not notice the many opportunities that are in front of our noses.
